hints.content: **Reflective (or line) symmetry** means that we can reflect a figure across a line, and the figure will remain unchanged.

##Reflection over $\overline{AE}$

Under this transformation, each point on the square maps to another point which is also on the square.


[[☃ image 1]]

The square is *symmetric* over this line.

options.alt: A square with vertices at A, C, G and E. Side A G has a midpoint H. Side C E has a midpoint D. All sides are congruent. Side A C has a midpoint B. Side G E has a midpoint F. A blue line connects from A to E and the image of the square is reflected across it to fit completely on the pre-image square.

A blue line connects from D to H and the image of the square is reflected across it to fit completely on the pre-image square.

hints.content:
The symmetries that apply to the square are:

Symmetry | Applies to the figure?
:- | :-:
Reflective symmetry over $\overline{AE}$ | Yes
Reflective symmetry over $\overline{DH}$ | Yes
